meta.note: 各平台 mod 元数据文件参考模板。analyze_porting_path 工具扫描这些文件来获取 modId 和 modName。

full.description: 完整的 fabric.mod.json（含客户端、datagen、custom 等）

minimal.example:
modLoader="javafml"
loaderVersion="[44,)"
license="MIT"

[[mods]]
modId="examplemod"
version="1.0.0"
displayName="Example Mod"
description='''An example mod'''

[[mods.modId.dependencies]]
modId="neoforge"
mandatory=true
versionRange="[20.2,)"
ordering="NONE"
side="BOTH"

full.example:
modLoader="javafml"
loaderVersion="[44,)"
license="MIT"
issueTrackerURL="https://github.com/example/examplemod/issues"

[[mods]]
modId="examplemod"
version="${file.jarVersion}"
displayName="Example Mod"
authors="Author Name (author@email.com)"
description='''
An example mod for NeoForge.

Features:
- Feature A
- Feature B
'''
logoFile="assets/examplemod/logo.png"
credits="Inspired by other mods"

[[mods.modId.contributors]]
contributor="Contributor Name"
description="Contributed feature X"

[[mods.modId.dependencies.examplemod]]
modId="neoforge"
type="required"
versionRange="[20.4,)"
ordering="NONE"
side="BOTH"

[[mods.modId.dependencies.examplemod]]
modId="minecraft"
type="required"
versionRange="*"
ordering="NONE"
side="BOTH"

[[mixins]]
config="examplemod.mixins.json"

[[clientMixins]]
config="examplemod.client.mixins.json"

breakingChanges.description: Forge → NeoForge 迁移时的 mods.toml 变更

changes.note: 不再强制要求 'forge'，直接用实际 modId

forge_mods_toml.description: mods.toml（旧版 Forge 1.20.1 使用，新项目推荐 neoforge.mods.toml）
forge_mods_toml.example:
modLoader="javafml"
loaderVersion="[47,)"
license="MIT"

[[mods]]
modId="examplemod"
version="${file.jarVersion}"
displayName="Example Mod"
authors="Author Name"
description='''An example mod for Forge'''

[[dependencies.examplemod]]
modId="forge"
mandatory=true
versionRange="[47.2.0,)"
ordering="NONE"
side="BOTH"

quilt_mod_json.description: quilt.mod.json（Quilt 加载器，与 Fabric 高度兼容）

quiltRelationship.description: Quilt 与 Fabric 的关系

quiltRelationship.recommendation: 如需同时支持 Fabric 和 Quilt，推荐使用 Architectury
